verses.1: Therefore, I ask that first of all, you should do all kinds of prayers, offerings, thanksgivings, and praise for all people.
verses.2: For the kings and all those who are in power, so that we may live a peaceful and tranquil life, with utmost piety and purity.
verses.3: This is something good and worthy of being presented before our savior, our God.
verses.4: He wants to save all people and lead them to the truth.
verses.5: For there is one God, and also one mediator between God and men—the man Jesus Christ.
verses.6: He makes himself an antidote for everything; the time of his suffering is determined by specific circumstances.
verses.7: To that place where I have been sent as a preacher and apostle—I tell the truth, I won’t lie—a teacher of nations, based on faith and truth.
verses.8: I therefore want to pray for those men in every place, while gathering as many hands as possible, free from anger and hesitation.
verses.9: Let women also dress themselves with modesty and propriety, without using sequins, gold, or other luxurious decorations.
verses.10: But what is necessary for a woman who is to be taught piety towards God, is to engage in good deeds.
verses.11: A woman should become wise in all circumstances.
verses.12: I do not allow women to teach, nor do I allow men to teach; they must remain in silence.
verses.13: Adam was the first to speak, then Eve.
verses.14: And Adam did not deceive; but the woman was deceived in her violation of the law.
verses.15: But one will be saved through the process of birth and rebirth, if they remain in faith, love, and holiness, along with righteousness.
